qualifications: All durations are sampled thread-stack residence, overlapping across threads, not CPU or wall time.
Excluding Monitor entry does not exclude native/pipe/file waiting or all other waits.
Selected inclusive contexts overlap; their times must not be summed.
ReadByte/Header residence may wait for the child to produce its header; it does not establish per-byte CPU overhead.

measurementLimits: Unity, Bee and provider phase scopes overlap and are nonadditive.
Win32 CPU seconds accumulate threads, not wall-clock time.
Win32 I/O transfer bytes include pipes/devices and cache traffic; they are not physical disk bytes.
Two-second process observations omit short-lived or inaccessible processes and final counter tails. Deltas are lower bounds.
Provider inner/outer deltas use actual observedAt endpoints with explicit boundary offsets; no interpolation.
Private-byte peaks are observed sample peaks, not full-system peak memory.
Command-line role classification is only available for identity-matched observed command lines.
Process ancestry attributes ownership, not every caller of a compiler server; server CPU is not attributed to individual compilation requests.
Bee event names and durations preserve event scope; absolute trace timestamp alignment is not assumed.
One A/B cohort; no randomized repeats or OS cache clearing. A and B are separate tasks, not statistical repetitions.
A setup also has one 30-second CLI EventPipe trace. Provider traces are two nonoverlapping 60-second windows.
The early-scan trace label is retained from the harness; its contents span scan/compile preparation and are not a pure Scan interval. There is no late-scan trace.
Trace launch timestamps bound attachment; process/provider window alignment is approximate, not an exact EventPipe first-event timestamp.
Sampled thread residence overlaps and is not CPU attribution or removable wall time.
Failure diagnosis/build/commit pause may affect cache state; active-operation sums explicitly exclude this pause. Actual continuous intervals retain it.
Git process identities are not decoder-start counts; transfer bytes are not physical disk or exact decoded bytes.
No source edits, Play/Test/build, whole physical allocation/RAM peak, OS failure or new support qualification.
Log capture/offline analysis overlap shutdown/reclamation; cleanup is not an isolated performance comparison.

inference.statement: An already started ILPP configuration action delayed return from obsolete-graph verification. Connection retries against an inherited old endpoint are consistent with the approximately sixty-second duration and observed trigger counters.

inference.timestampOptimizationCausality: Not confirmed: the logs show the scheduling order but do not isolate why this candidate launched the old-graph configuration action before invalidation.
